items.title: File Fayette County business personal property return
items.description: Kentucky tangible personal property returns are filed with the county Property Valuation Administrator by May 15; there is no extension. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File the Lexington-Fayette occupational license fee withholding return (Forms 220/221)
items.authority: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government, Division of Revenue
items.description: Employers withhold the 2.25% license fee from wages for work performed in Fayette County. Withholding of $300 or more a quarter is filed monthly; under $300 quarterly. The exact due days were not in the pages read; Form 222 is the annual employee reconciliation.

items.title: File the Lexington-Fayette net profit license fee return (Form 228)
items.authority: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government, Division of Revenue
items.description: Businesses file Form 228 and pay the 2.25% net profit license fee (annual minimum $100) by the 15th day of the fourth month after the fiscal year ends, mid-April for calendar-year businesses. Estimated quarterly payments are required when the fee exceeds $5,000.

note: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government requires an occupational license for businesses and levies a transient room tax (reported at 8.5% by a third-party guide), but their due dates were not found.

items.title: File Jefferson County business personal property return
items.description: Kentucky tangible personal property returns are filed with the county Property Valuation Administrator by May 15; there is no extension.

items.title: File the Louisville Metro transient room tax return
items.description: Hosts and hotels register with the Revenue Commission and file and pay electronically (EMINTS account) by the last day of the month after the rental month. The Metro rate is 8.5%, and it does not apply to stays of 30 days or more. Form TR1M is for direct bookings; booking platforms use TR1M-P.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Louisville Metro occupational license tax withholding return (Form W-1)
items.description: Employers withhold the occupational license tax on wages earned in Jefferson County (2.2% for residents, 1.45% for non-residents) and file Form W-1 each quarter by the last day of the month after the quarter. Employers that withheld more than $3,000 in any of the four preceding quarters instead make monthly deposits (Form W-1D) due 15 days after the month ends.

items.title: File the Louisville Metro net profit license tax return (Form OL-3)
items.description: Any business with nexus in Louisville/Jefferson County files Form OL-3 and pays the net profit tax (2.2% resident, 1.45% non-resident rate) by the 15th day of the fourth month after its fiscal year ends (April 15 for calendar-year businesses). An extension of time to file does not extend payment.
